name: abhi2
description: Abhi2.0 AI-powered Gmail client management system

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n backend,frontend -c yellow,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace apps/frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -k -n backend,worker,frontend -c yellow,cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace apps/backend" "npm run worker --workspace apps/backend" "npm run dev --workspace apps/frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @abhi2/shared && npm run build --workspace apps/backend && npm run build --workspace apps/frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace @abhi2/shared && npm run test --workspace apps/backend && npm run test --workspace apps/frontend
